summary: Story roll-up for assistant, re-reviewed on the merged tree at ac1c187. All 25 plan contracts across the four tasks verdict IMPLEMENTED, each carried from that task's own sealed review, and every one of those four reviews closed at 10/approve on all three lenses with zero findings (#42, #43, #44, #45). python3 factory/scripts/verify.py passes across structural, typecheck, quality and test on the merged tree. The story took 4 tasks and 10 review rounds in total; the recurring defect class was a surface disagreeing with what the governed path would actually do - the saved-selection runnable check omitting first the 'report' action and then row-level scope, and an Open handler navigating when the re-run had been rejected as pending. Each was caught by a lens, verified against the code before being acted on, and fixed.
non_blocking_findings: D-0024 and D-0031 remain open, so every leaf in this story was judged by its junit testcase NAME and EXECUTED count rather than an exit code.

The mandatory design skills required orchestrator intervention on task 4: frontend-design showed zero occurrences across three delegate job logs while one run's summary claimed it was applied. The orchestrator read and applied it directly, which found a real defect (raw ApiError text rendered to users).
